name: Reversi
shortDescription: Trap your opponent's discs to flip them to your colour. Most discs when no one can move wins.
rules:
8×8 board, starting with 4 discs in the centre. Black moves first.

Each move must **trap** at least one line of opponent discs (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) between the new disc and one of yours. Every trapped line is **flipped** to your colour.

If you have no legal move, you **pass**. When neither side can move, the game ends and the side with **more discs** wins.

errors.out_of_bounds: That cell is outside the board.
errors.no_flips: That move doesn't flip any disc.
